items.q: What is the minimum age for cannabis delivery in Lyndhurst?
items.a_html: New Jersey's adult-use cannabis law requires customers to be 21 or older to place a delivery order. Age is verified during account setup, and your driver confirms your ID at the door before completing the handoff. No exceptions apply.

items.q: What kinds of ID can I use for delivery orders?
items.a_html: Valid, government-issued photo IDs are accepted across the board. Driver's licenses, state-issued IDs, and passports all qualify, and out-of-state IDs are welcome. Have your ID uploaded to your Lady L account before placing your first order, and keep the physical one on hand for when your driver arrives.

items.q: Is a medical card required to receive cannabis delivery in Lyndhurst?
items.a_html: No medical card is needed. Lady L operates as an adult-use dispensary, open to any customer 21 or older. A confirmed account and a valid ID are the only things standing between you and your first order.

items.q: How much cannabis can a delivery order include?
items.a_html:
New Jersey law caps each transaction at the equivalent of 28.35 grams, or one ounce, of usable cannabis. That total can draw from any combination of the following:

  • Dried Flower/Bud: 28.35 grams (1 ounce).
  • Concentrates/Resin/Oils: 4 grams (solid or liquid/vaporized oil).
  • Ingestible Items (Gummies/Edibles): 1,000 mg of THC (roughly ten 100mg packages).
  • Maximum Possession Limit: Up to 6 ounces of cannabis and cannabis products.
  • Mixing Products: You can mix and match, for example, by purchasing 1/2 ounce of flower and 2 grams of concentrates.
  • Daily Limits: The 1-ounce limit is generally considered a daily limit across all dispensaries.

items.q: What are the tax rates on Lyndhurst weed delivery orders?
items.a_html: New Jersey adult-use cannabis purchases include a 6.625% state sales tax, a 2% municipal transfer or user tax, where applicable, and a Social Equity Excise Fee (SEEF) of $2.50 per ounce. Every applicable charge is itemized at checkout before you confirm, and delivery orders are taxed the same as in-store purchases.
